About College
Govt. Model Women College, Bilasipara, is a premier institution established by the Government of Assam to disseminate higher education among the women in the Bilasipara area and throughout Assam. Although the college was initially established for women, from the 2024-25 academic year onwards, the institution has received permission for co-education, allowing both boys and girls to pursue higher studies here.
The college is located in Chirakuta Village, Bilasipara in Dhubri district. It was established in 2023 by the Assam government to meet the region's educational needs. The college is situated adjacent to the SDO Civil's Office, Bilasipara, amidst scenic surroundings, creating a peaceful and suitable learning environment. The institution is affiliated with Gauhati University and offers a Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) with six departments: Assamese, English, Economics, Education, History, and Political Science. The wide range of departments emphasizes the college's dedication to providing a well-rounded education that fits the demands of students from all backgrounds. The enthusiastic faculty members bring knowledge, experience, and passion to the classroom, fostering academic excellence and personal growth. They play a crucial role in helping the new generation grow academically, psychologically, and intellectually. With its commitment to quality education and holistic development, Govt. Model Women College, Bilasipara, holds the potential to become a premier educational institution in the region, empowering students and contributing to the community's overall development.
